{"message":"Hi! To see if your weekly report is still set up correctly, follow these steps:

1. In the Meridian app, go to **Settings → Reports → Scheduled**.
2. Find your weekly report in the list. The run history will show the outcome of the most recent run.
   * If it shows a *failed* run, the report ran but delivery failed.
   * If it shows *disabled*, the schedule itself was turned off.
3. If the run history looks fine, check the recipient list. A report will keep running even if one address starts bouncing, but delivery to that address will pause after repeated failures. This can make it look like the whole report stopped.

Review the run history first, then verify that none of the recipients are experiencing bounces. That should tell you whether the schedule is still active and why the report stopped arriving.

arguments.message:
Hi! To see if your weekly report is still set up correctly, follow these steps:

1. In the Meridian app, go to **Settings → Reports → Scheduled**.
2. Find your weekly report in the list. The run history will show the outcome of the most recent run.
   * If it shows a *failed* run, the report ran but delivery failed.
   * If it shows *disabled*, the schedule itself was turned off.
3. If the run history looks fine, check the recipient list. A report will keep running even if one address starts bouncing, but delivery to that address will pause after repeated failures. This can make it look like the whole report stopped.

Review the run history first, then verify that none of the recipients are experiencing bounces. That should tell you whether the schedule is still active and why the report stopped arriving.
